title.narrative: South Asia Subregional Economic Cooperation Roads Improvement Project

description.narrative: The project will rehabilitate and upgrade in terms of capacity, quality, and safety, about 160 kilometers (km) of Nepal's strategic road network, which comprise a critical section of the country's main East-West highway and its feeder road. It will improve transport connectivity in Nepal, with a focus on providing faster and better access to social services and economic opportunities. The project roads are also integral to the international and regional road network system that connects Nepal to India, and will facilitate closer trade integration and contribute to Nepal's export competitiveness. The project will have a transformational impact by facilitating national and regional integration.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3478: 76% of contracts awarded and 62% disbursed as of 23 Apr 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: Contract for Bhairahawa-Lumbini-Taulihawa Road (BLT) awarded in June 2017 to M/s Gawar Construction. Contractor commenced work in July 2017. Contract for Narayanghat-Butwal Road (NB-01 & NB-02) awarded in Dec 2018 to M/s China State Construction Engineering Corp. Ltd.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jan 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48337/48337-002-apfs-en_6.pdf
Some results are in the Environmental Impact Assessments | Aug 2016: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//48337-002-eia-02.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Oct 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48337/48337-002-rp-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Apr 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48337/48337-002-smr-en_25.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Three civil works packages awarded to upgrade (i) Bhairahawa-Lumbini-Taulihawa, and (ii) Narayanghat-Butwal roads.
The construction works for Bhairahawa-Lumbini-Taulihawa road section was completed in December 2022 and is under extended defects notification period till 31 December 2022.
Two civil work packages were awarded for NB roads and includes 5 yrs PMBC provision. These contracts were awarded in December 2018 and contractor started work in the site from October 2019. As of 30 November 2022, the overall progress of both packages is about 22% and works have been substantially. The contractors has demonstrated preparedness to complete construction work within the extended contract period. ADB and executing agency have regularly visited field and monitoring progress on a bi-monthly basis.
Traffic safety and gender friendly design assessment completed for Bharahawa-Lumbini-Taulihawa road and ongoing for NB roads.
